title: Santa Rita Hotel

terrainReference.basis: Today’s original terrain elevation sampled at the former hotel’s Scott Avenue entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: Library of Congress, 1919 Sanborn map of Tucson, sheet 8, block 864; OpenStreetMap centerlines for modern registration.
mapIdentity.scope: The original 1919 Sanborn sheet, registered from South Scott Avenue, fixes the approximately 38 by 71 m site, including the front porch and wing depth. The public-domain Qualla postcard fixes the Scott Avenue profile.

note: The Qualla postcard shows four main levels at the Broadway corner, a decorated parapet, a recessed two-arch central range, a low arcade and a taller south addition. The Sanborn annotations identify four original floors, fifth-floor frame above portions of the lobby and a sixth-floor sun parlor in the addition.
